item.title: NFL salary cap hits new milestone at $301.2 million as part of 40% increase over 5 years
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — The NFL salary cap has topped $300 million for the first time, landing at $301.2 million in 2026 for a $22 million increase over last year. The cap has increased 40% in just five years, since it dropped coming off the pandemic-altered 2020 season when few or no fans were allowed to attend games. item.title: Penguins nip Monsters, 3-2, to snap seven-game home winning streak
item.description: The Monsters’ seven-game winning streak at Rocket Arena came to an end on Feb. 27 when the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins scored twice in the first eight minutes of the first period and held on to win, 3-2. item.title: Pistons outlast short-handed Cavaliers, 122-119, in OT after blaring horn delay
item.description: By DAVE HOGG DETROIT — Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cavaliers, 122-119, on March 27 in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.
